summary: Backend engineer with 6 years building Python REST services on PostgreSQL, Apache Airflow orchestration, and Docker/Kubernetes deployment.

bullets.text: Designed Python REST API services powering the customer billing platform at Cascade Data Works.
Tuned PostgreSQL indexes and query plans for the billing platform's core tables at Cascade Data Works.
Built Apache Airflow DAGs orchestrating the nightly billing-reconciliation pipeline at Northbridge Analytics.
Deployed every pipeline service with Docker and wrote the Kubernetes manifests used in staging at Northbridge Analytics.
